description: This file defines the MCPClientRegistry class, a registry managing MCPClient instances, including registration, retrieval, listing, and health checks for MCP servers.

classes.name: MCPClientRegistry
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of MCPClient instances, allowing registration, retrieval, listing, and health monitoring of MCP servers.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Constructs a new MCPClientRegistry, optionally in development mode.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new MCPClient with the given server configuration and adds it to the registry.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an MCPClient by its alias.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns an array of all registered MCPClient instances.

methods.name: healthSummary
methods.description: Performs a health check across all registered MCPClient instances and returns a summary.

ctags.name: clients
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly clients = new Map<string, MCPClient>();$/

fields.name: private readonly clients = new Map<string, MCPClient>();
